textCmdUCDesc: Check Universidad Catolica match schedule and availability conflicts
textCmdUCConfigDesc: Configure this server's UC-fan friend and proactive alert channel
textSubConfigSetDesc: Set the UC-fan friend or proactive alert channel for this server
textSubConfigShowDesc: Show this server's UC-fan friend and alert channel configuration
textSubConfigClearDesc: Clear this server's UC-fan friend, alert channel, or both
textOptDateDesc: Specific date (DD/MM or YYYY-MM-DD, Santiago time)
textOptFriendDesc: Server member whose availability follows UC matches
textOptChannelDesc: Text channel for Friday and matchday UC alerts
textMatchTBDLine: 🟡 **%s** (%s - %s) on **%s %s**: kickoff hour still TBD by ANFP for %s.
textBanterBlockedHome: Do not count on %s during that window; stadium trip in progress.
textBanterBlockedAway: Do not count on %s during that window; glued to the screen for UC.
textBanterPending: ANFP has not released the exact kickoff hour yet; making plans with %s is at your own risk.
textBanterFree: UC does not play in this window, so %s has no excuse to skip plans.
textNextMatchConfirmed: *(Heads up - next match: **%s** (%s) on **%s %s** at %s (%s), blocking **%s to %s**.)*
textNextMatchTBD: *(Heads up - next match: **%s** (%s) on **%s %s**, kickoff hour still pending ANFP.)*
textAlertFridayFallback: Plan the weekend around those windows before committing.
textAlertMatchdayLine: ⚠️ **Matchday alert:** Today at %s (%s) UC plays: **%s** (%s). %s is unavailable from **%s to %s**.
